SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)) calc, sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-11-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH d AS (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27'),
w AS (SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, w.n, w.g FROM d LEFT JOIN w ON w.sale_date=d.calendar_date WHERE w.n IS NULL OR w.n < 80 OR w.n > 250 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, sum(gross_amount) g, count(*) c, min(sale_date) sd FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN abs(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.c<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lc_mismatch, sum(l.g) lines_g, sum(o.order_total_gross) ord_g,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts_utc)) AS DATE)<>l.sd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff
FROM l JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE l.sd BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2024-10-27'
